page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.20xlarge is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the ecs.hfr6 instance family. Powered by a KVM hypervisor, it features 80 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs based on Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The instance is provisioned with 768.0 GB of system memory, which delivers a ratio of 9.6 GB of RAM per vCPU core. Network capabilities include a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. It does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The hardware configuration provides zero bundled local storage and zero GPU accelerators, requiring all persistent storage to be attached remotely over the network. The provisioned resource profile emphasizes high memory density paired with 80 dedicated compute cores. This resource structure renders the instance suited for in-memory databases, large Redis or Memcached clusters, enterprise resource planning systems, data analytics, and memory-heavy backend software.
